defs.def: a way of sending messages and data to other people by means of computers connected together in a network 电子邮件（通信方式）

ex.s: The technology could determine whether a driver had just texted, emailed or done anything else that is not allowed under New York's hands-free driving laws.
ex.t: 该技术能判断司机是否刚刚发过短信、邮件或做了纽约免提驾驶法所不允许的其他事情。

ex.s: I found the contact information of the company____40____ emailed its president.
ex.t: 我找到了这家公司的联系方式并____40____给其总裁发了邮件。

ex.s: The unwilling parent organizes the meal schedule, sends out emails, and collects money for end-of-season gifts.
ex.t: 那位不情愿的家长安排用餐时间表、发送电子邮件，并为赛季末礼物筹集资金。

ex.s: Gordon says his students are emailing daily with NASA engineers about the problem, readying a workable solution to test in space.
ex.t: 戈登说，他的学生每天就这个问题与NASA工程师邮件往来，准备一个可在太空测试的可行方案。

ex.s: So imagine my   42   when he emailed me saying he wanted to come to visit me.
ex.t: 所以想想他发邮件说想来看望我时，我该有多么惊讶吧。

ex.s: they send emails in errorB. they fail to work interactively
ex.t: 他们发错了邮件B. 他们未能互动合作

ex.s: Whenever I heard of businesses using plastic, I'd send an email.
ex.t: 每当我听说有企业使用塑料，就发一封邮件。

ex.s: Emojis are used everywhere, from text messages to emails, blogs and other social media networks.
ex.t: 表情符号无处不在，从短信到电子邮件、博客以及其他社交媒体网络都在使用。

ex.s: In many countries, the elderly can receive free training in the use of computers, and learn how to correspond by email, how to send photos and voice messages, and how to use the Internet for shopping and other services.
ex.t: 在许多国家，老年人可以接受免费的电脑使用培训，学习如何通过电子邮件通信，如何发送照片和语音消息，以及如何使用互联网购物和获取其他服务。

ex.s: Recommended place: What it is like: Reasons for recommendation: Now write your email.
ex.t: 推荐地点： 它是什么样的： 推荐理由： 现在写下你的邮件。

ex.s: If the information you’re communicating isn’t urgent, consider sending an email.
ex.t: 如果你传达的信息并不紧急，考虑发一封邮件。

ex.s: When I received the ___17___ email, I felt disappointed and angry.
ex.t: 当我收到那封____17____邮件时，我感到失望又愤怒。

ex.s: So I was shocked when, not long after the email, Professor Mary Devon, who was running the programme, invited me to observe the work being done in her lab.
ex.t: 所以，在那封邮件之后不久，负责该项目的玛丽·德文教授邀请我去观察她的实验室工作时，我感到非常震惊。

ex.s: With the current footprint of humanity, “it seems that global collapse is certain to happen in some form, possibly within a decade, certainly within this century,” Johnson said in an email.
ex.t: 约翰逊在电子邮件中说，以人类目前的足迹来看，“全球崩溃似乎注定会以某种形式发生，可能在本十年内，肯定在本世纪内”。

ex.s: I decided that if I learned of a company____39____ used a lot of plastic, I'd send it an email urging it to cut back.
ex.t: 我决定，如果得知哪家公司____39____大量使用塑料，就给它发邮件敦促它减少使用。

ex.s: Who hasn’t received an email so annoying that it ruined an entire day? ___39___.
ex.t: 谁没有收到过一封烦人到毁了整天的邮件呢？___39___。

defs.def: a message sent by email 电子邮件

ex.s: Once the registration form is received and processed, we will send a confirmation email within two business days.
ex.t: 一旦收到并处理注册表，我们将在两个工作日内发送确认邮件。

ex.s: A: … [3 Complete the email with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
ex.t: A：…… [3 用括号中动词的正确形式完成这封邮件。

ex.s: I’m contactable via email at this address or by phone on 6747-9818.
ex.t: 你可以通过这个地址的邮件联系到我，或者打电话 6747-9818。

ex.s: For a physical item, you will be notified by email when it arrives.
ex.t: 对于实体物品，到达时你会收到电子邮件通知。

ex.s: For an article or book chapter, you will be notified by email when it is available.
ex.t: 对于文章或书籍章节，当其可用时，你会收到电子邮件通知。

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

ex.s: *Log in to Handshake using your email address already provided by the college.
ex.t: 使用学院已提供的邮箱地址登录Handshake。

ex.s: attend job trainingD. set up a new email account
ex.t: 参加工作培训 D. 建立一个新的邮箱账户

ex.s: My heart raced when I saw the email sender’s name.
ex.t: 当我看到邮件发件人的名字时，我的心跳加速了。

ex.s: How did the author feel upon seeing the email sender’s name?
ex.t: 看到邮件发件人的名字时，作者是什么感受？

ex.s: We will email you if a place becomes available or if a new session is to be held.
ex.t: 如果有名额空出或要举办新活动，我们会给你发邮件。

ex.s: When you are placed on a waiting list, we will email you a number which tells you where you are on the list.
ex.t: 当你被列入等候名单时，我们会给你发邮件告知一个号码，表明你在名单上的位置。

ex.s: You’ll be informed by email if you are being deregistered as a result of missing sessions.
ex.t: 如果因缺席活动而被注销，你会收到邮件通知。

ex.s: If you believe you have received the email in error, email the PASS office at  passoffice@umbs. edu..
ex.t: 如果你认为收到邮件有误，请发邮件至passoffice@umbs.edu..

ex.s: Email the office their numbers on the list.
ex.t: 发邮件给办公室他们在名单上的号码。

ex.s: Even a formal email can seem cold and unfriendly
ex.t: 即使是正式的邮件也可能显得冷淡而不友好

ex.s: And it's all supported by an efficient customer service team, available through telephone, email and online chat.
ex.t: 这一切都由一个高效的客服团队支持，可通过电话、电子邮件和在线聊天联系。

ex.s: Email:humanresources@glodeve.org
ex.t: 加入我们成为一名志愿者管理者，在为社区带来好处的同时发展自己的技能。
